description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Water with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode] and [Crystal Force Mode: Gogo (V) (Water)] to the user

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions

description.name: Crystal Force Mode: Gogo (V) (Water)
description.text: Water abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Water abilities trigger 1 additional time, [DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)], removed if user hasn't Crystal Force Mode
